title: Tall white electronics that read and implant thoughts

tellings.quote: And of course their electronics also are able to tell what a person is thinking and to put thoughts in the conscious part of their mind by electronic means.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent 1965 to 1967 at Indian Springs in the Nevada desert alongside tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites, says their machines could read minds. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that their electronics could tell what a person was thinking and could also put thoughts into the conscious part of someone's mind. If that were true, it would mean these beings could shape what people think without anyone noticing.
